findings.title: Release notes/changelog are maintained manually
evidence: CHANGELOG.md documents the format but is hand-maintained
No script generates changelog/release notes from commits or tags
findings.impact: Manual notes can drift or be omitted, weakening the release lineage the file promises.
findings.recommendation: Add a generator (e.g. conventional-commits or git-cliff) and wire it to the release process.

report: Release artifacts: CHANGELOG.md exists with an append-only Keep-a-Changelog format and a documented release lineage process, but generation is manual. Residual: no automated release-notes/changelog generator wired to tags.
